title: Tent of Meeting at Shiloh

questions.question: Where did the whole congregation assemble to set up the tent of meeting?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 (ESV): "Then the whole congregation... assembled at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there."

questions.question: How many tribes had not yet received their inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:2 (ESV): "There remained among the people of Israel seven tribes whose inheritance had not yet been apportioned."

questions.question: What did Joshua ask the people regarding their delay?
options: "How long will you be slack to go in and take possession of the land?"
"Do you want to return to Egypt?"
questions.correctAnswer: "How long will you be slack to go in and take possession of the land?"
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:3 (ESV): "How long will you be slack to go in and take possession of the land..."

questions.question: How many men from each tribe were to be chosen to map the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:4 (ESV): "Appoint three men from each tribe."

questions.question: For which tribe did the first lot come up?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:11 (ESV): "The lot of the tribe of the people of Benjamin came up..."

questions.question: Into how many portions were they to describe/divide the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:6 (ESV): "And you shall describe the land in seven divisions and bring the description here to me."

questions.question: Where would Joshua cast lots for them?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:6 (ESV): "...and I will cast lots for you here before the Lord our God."

questions.question: The territory of Benjamin lay between which two tribes?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:11 (ESV): "...and the territory allotted to it lay between the people of Judah and the people of Joseph."

questions.question: What famous city is listed in Benjamin's inheritance?
Joshua mentions that the priesthood of the Lord is whose inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 (ESV): "The Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance."

questions.question: The border of Benjamin went down to the mountain that overlooks the Valley of Hinnom, which is where?
options: At the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim
questions.correctAnswer: At the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:16 (ESV): "...which is at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim..."

questions.question: And the border passing En-shemesh went down to where?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:17 (ESV): "...and passed along to En-shemesh and went down to En-rogel..."

questions.question: The Stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben is a marker for which boundary?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:17 (ESV): "...and went down to the Stone of Bohan the son of Reuben."

questions.question: Which Jericho is mentioned in Benjamin's cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:21 (ESV): "Now the cities of the tribe of Benjamin... used to be Jericho..."

questions.question: Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth are cities of which tribe?

key_verse_text: Then the whole congregation of the people of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The land lay subdued before them. (ESV)
